title: Retrograde Planets
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 3 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Why remedies cost a sacrifice, twelve sign natures and timing, the planets as a family, hosts and guests, Venus, Ketu, Jupiter, outer planets, cord cutting and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 3, Retrograde Planets by Brajesh Gautam: sacrifice, sign natures, planets as a family, host rule, cord cutting, with video timestamps.
points: Pay in money, early and quietly, rather than in time, body or peace.
